Radio5 Events presents...

🩸 OBSESSION 2026 🩸The Biggest Bollywood Halloween Party in Los Angeles

This October 31st, the upscale Fitoor in Santa Monica awakens for the most iconic Desi Halloween tradition — a night where shadows dance, costumes slay, and the music takes full possession of your soul.

🩸 Why Obsession?Step into a night of obsession, horror, and nonstop vibes as Fitoor transforms into a blood-soaked Halloween celebration inspired by the year’s most unforgettable psychological thrillers and slasher films. Dress to K*ll. Dance like you’re the last one left. 🔪🩸

📍 FITOORExperience the gorgeous Fitoor in Santa Monica off the famous OCEAN BLVD for a complete Halloween takeover of the entire space.

THE MUSICExperience dj sets from the best South Asian deejays playing nothing but Bollywood bangers, 90’s–2000’s Filmy hits, Hiphop, Afrohouse and Club Anthems all night long.

DRESS CODE🩸 Costume encouraged 🎃 Halloween décor & photo ops 💀 A packed dance floor with spooky surprises throughout the night.

Whether you’re the final girl, the villain, or completely unhinged, this is your invitation to embrace your darkest obsession.
